Beta — captain-intel sources not yet wired; picks rank on seasonal presence + SST fit + reef/wreck proximity until captain heat scores populate. v24.44 added Pass B: Naples, Marco, 10K Islands, Everglades, Boca Grande, Charlotte Harbor, Sanibel, FL Middle Grounds.

home_port.name: Bud N' Mary's Marina (Islamorada)
home_port.notes: Islamorada default — self-declared Sportfishing Capital of the World. Central for Keys + short run to Islamorada Hump + Wood Wall Gulf Stream.

boat.notes: Same profile as Zone 1 default — visitor customizes via ⚓ chip.

zones.name: Jupiter Ledge
zones.notes: Legendary ledge system 2-4mi off Jupiter Inlet. Sailfish and kingfish rip through Nov-Mar; mahi + wahoo summer.

zones.name: West Palm Sailfish Grounds
zones.notes: The Sailfish Capital of the World's home ground. Kite fishing off the Palm Beach ledge. Winter sailfish tournaments.

zones.name: Palm Beach Reef Line
zones.notes: The three-line reef system parallel to the beach 100-500 yards out. Kingfish + cobia migrations, structure fishing.

zones.name: Boynton / Boca Ledge
zones.notes: The offshore ledge between Boynton and Boca inlets. Sailfish drifts + summer mahi push.

zones.name: Hillsboro Reef Complex
zones.notes: The three-line reef off Hillsboro Inlet. Popular drift + wreck fishing area, wall of wrecks nearby.

zones.name: Fort Lauderdale Reef Lines
zones.notes: Classic three-line reef system straight out of Port Everglades. Inner (60'), middle (100'), outer (180-250').

zones.name: Fort Lauderdale Wreck Alley
zones.notes: Blue Fire, Copenhagen, Rebel, Papa Doc — one of the densest artificial reef systems in FL. AJ + grouper stack here.

zones.name: Hollywood / Dania Reef
zones.notes: The reefs off Hollywood/Dania Beach. Live-bait kingfish drift country + Dania Pier tarpon in summer.

zones.name: Government Cut / Miami Inlet
zones.notes: Miami's primary inlet. Legendary tarpon fishery in the cut Apr-Jul (150-lb+ fish common). Kingfish rip through winter.

zones.name: Fowey Rocks
zones.notes: Iconic reef + light structure at the edge of the Gulf Stream. Where captains start their offshore drift for sails.

zones.name: Stiltsville / Biscayne Flats
zones.notes: The Biscayne Bay flats. Bonefish, tarpon, permit — the trifecta on fly. Stiltsville houses are the landmark.

zones.name: Miami 190 Trough
zones.notes: The Gulf Stream offshore trough. Kite fishing sails + trolling for mahi. Swordfish deep drop after dark.

zones.name: Biscayne Outer Reef
zones.notes: The outer reef line off Biscayne Bay. Yellowtail chum fishery + mutton snapper on the drop-off.

zones.name: Islamorada Hump
zones.notes: The famous 500-800' seamount 20mi south of Islamorada. Blackfin tuna live-bait mecca + AJ jigging + big kings.

zones.name: Alligator Reef Light
zones.notes: Iconic 1873 lighthouse marking Islamorada's premier reef. Yellowtail chum fishery + reef stack.

zones.name: Molasses Reef (Key Largo)
zones.notes: Key Largo's premier reef spot in Pennekamp Park. Massive yellowtail chum lines + tropical stack.

zones.name: Upper Keys Wreck Trek
zones.notes: Duane, Bibb, Spiegel Grove, USS Vandenberg-class wrecks. Deep AJ + grouper + permit on the wrecks in June.

zones.name: Marathon West Hump
zones.notes: Deep-drop seamount 15mi south of Marathon. Blackfin tuna paradise + AJ + wahoo trolls.

zones.name: Sombrero Reef
zones.notes: Marathon's iconic reef with the 1858 lighthouse. Yellowtail chum + snorkel-tourist mecca.

zones.name: Seven Mile Bridge / Channel
zones.notes: Structure fishing at the bridge pilings. Tarpon migration Apr-Jul stacks under the arches at night.

zones.name: Bahia Honda Bridge
zones.notes: Legendary tarpon spot at the old bridge remnants. Also the Bahia Honda channel is a permit + bonefish flat.

zones.name: Sand Key
zones.notes: Key West's home reef with the 1853 lighthouse. Yellowtail + mutton snapper stack all season.

zones.name: Cottrell Key
zones.notes: Offshore reef complex NW of Key West. Deep mutton snapper + grouper drop-off, less pressure than Sand Key.

zones.name: Marquesas Keys
zones.notes: The wildest flats + backcountry in the Keys. Permit paradise. Tarpon migration staging area April-June.

zones.name: Key West Wreck Line (Vandenberg+)
zones.notes: USS Vandenberg (525-ft wreck, world class) + Alexander's Wreck + Cayman Salvager. AJ jigging + permit April-June.

zones.name: Dry Tortugas
zones.notes: 70mi west of Key West. Untouched grouper + mutton fishery. Multi-day trip territory. Fort Jefferson is the landmark.

zones.name: Islamorada 409 Hole
zones.notes: Deep Gulf Stream hole SE of Islamorada. Live-bait blackfin + swordfish deep drop after dark.

zones.name: The Wood Wall (Islamorada Offshore)
zones.notes: The Gulf Stream western wall — the color change captains chase. Sails + mahi + wahoo on the temperature break.

zones.name: Naples City Pier
zones.notes: Naples' iconic pier — daytime snook + trout, evening tarpon rolls in summer. Kids-friendly access to Gulf.

zones.name: Doctor's Pass (Naples)
zones.notes: Naples' main inlet pass. Strong tidal flow attracts snook + redfish; cobia sight-fishing on the beach spring.

zones.name: Naples Offshore Ledges
zones.notes: The 60-80' ledge system 15-25nm offshore Naples. Grouper + snapper stacks + winter kingfish drift.

zones.name: Marco Pass
zones.notes: Marco Island's main inlet — mangrove-lined creeks feed the pass; snook + redfish on the flats + oyster bars.

zones.name: Cape Romano Shoals
zones.notes: The shoals SW of Marco Island. Wading + skiff flats for redfish + trout. Permit occasional on the outer shoals.

zones.name: Ten Thousand Islands
zones.notes: Untouched maze of mangrove islands S of Marco. Skiff-only wilderness fishery; snook + redfish on virtually every point.

zones.name: Chokoloskee / Everglades City
zones.notes: The launch point for Everglades backcountry. Chokoloskee Bay + Turner River. Guides run out of here for wilderness snook/redfish trips.

zones.name: Flamingo (Florida Bay)
zones.notes: S. tip of Everglades National Park — the border between Gulf and Florida Bay. Backcountry snook + Florida Bay bones/permit/tarpon.

zones.name: Florida Bay Flats
zones.notes: The vast shallow flats between the mainland and the Keys. Backcountry paradise — Islamorada guides run over here for backcountry days.

zones.name: Boca Grande Pass
zones.notes: TARPON CAPITAL OF THE WORLD. May-July the pass is packed with 150+ boats live-baiting for 100-200lb tarpon. World Series of Tarpon.

zones.name: Charlotte Harbor
zones.notes: Second-largest estuary in FL. Placida to Punta Gorda. Snook + redfish flats + tarpon migrating in from Boca Grande.

zones.name: Pine Island Sound
zones.notes: Between Pine Island and Sanibel/Captiva. Grass flats + oyster bars — classic SW FL inshore stack.

zones.name: Sanibel Causeway
zones.notes: Bridge pilings between Ft Myers and Sanibel. Snook + tarpon night bite under the lights; kingfish + mackerel outside.

zones.name: Florida Middle Grounds
zones.notes: 80-120nm W of Ft Myers/Tampa. Massive live-bottom ecosystem. Multi-day grouper + AJ trips. Cooler-water refugia in a hot Gulf.

zones.name: Sailfish Alley North (Juno-Jupiter)
zones.notes: Nov-Mar sailfish migration corridor. Kite fishing edge of Gulf Stream.

zones.name: Loran Tower Wreck
zones.notes: Sunken navigation tower. Structure fish year-round.

zones.name: Governor's Reef
zones.notes: Artificial reef complex. Bottom fishing + trolling.

zones.name: The Trench (Palm Beach)
zones.notes: Deep-water ledge east of Palm Beach. Wahoo winter/spring.

zones.name: Juno Ledge South
zones.notes: Extension of Jupiter Ledge system south of Juno. Live-bait sails.

zones.name: West End Bank (Bahamas Edge)
zones.notes: Bahamas Edge run — 45nm ESE Palm Beach. Wahoo March-May, marlin summer.

zones.name: Copenhagen Wreck
zones.notes: 1900 shipwreck in 25ft. Snapper + cobia on wreck.

zones.name: Rebel Wreck
zones.notes: 185ft freighter sunk 1985. Deep drop for grouper + goliath.

zones.name: Ancient Mariner Wreck
zones.notes: 185ft coastal freighter. Excellent structure.

zones.name: Hillsboro Ledge (Deep)
zones.notes: Second reef ledge north Fort Lauderdale. Sailfish winter.

zones.name: 65-Foot Ledge (Ft. Lauderdale)
zones.notes: Classic reef ledge 3nm off Port Everglades.

zones.name: Bahamas Edge (Ft Lauderdale)
zones.notes: Gulf Stream to Bahamas Edge run. Trolling for pelagics.

zones.name: Neptune Memorial Reef
zones.notes: Artificial reef 3.25mi E of Miami Beach. Big amberjack.

zones.name: Miami 150 Ledge
zones.notes: 150ft depth ledge. Bottom fishing + trolling combo.

zones.name: Miami Gulf Stream Edge
zones.notes: Inner edge of Gulf Stream. Kite fishing sails winter.

zones.name: Orion Wreck
zones.notes: 119ft Coast Guard cutter sunk 1985.

zones.name: Almirante Wreck (Miami)
zones.notes: 197ft freighter. Deep structure drop.

zones.name: Miami-Bimini Run
zones.notes: 50nm Bimini/Bahamas Bank edge. Pelagic run summer.

zones.name: Molasses Reef
zones.notes: Iconic UK reef 6mi SE Key Largo. Ultra popular light tackle.

zones.name: Alligator Reef
zones.notes: Historic lighthouse reef 4mi SE Islamorada.

zones.name: Pickles Reef
zones.notes: Shallow reef, big yellowtail + hogfish.

zones.name: Islamorada 180 (Deep)
zones.notes: 180-fathom curve S of Islamorada Hump. Sword daytime.

zones.name: Sombrero Reef
zones.notes: Lighthouse reef 4mi S Marathon. Yellowtail + sails.

zones.name: Marathon East Hump
zones.notes: Underwater seamount 3nm E of West Hump. Blackfin schools.

zones.name: Content Keys Wall
zones.notes: Deep wall system. Good grouper structure.

zones.name: Looe Key Reef
zones.notes: Sanctuary reef 6mi S of Big Pine. Yellowtail hotspot.

zones.name: American Shoal Reef
zones.notes: Big offshore reef complex W of Looe. Full-day trip.

zones.name: Riley's Hump
zones.notes: Legendary mutton snapper spawning site 60nm W Key West. Regulated.

zones.name: Rebecca Shoal
zones.notes: Shoal between Marquesas and Tortugas. Mutton snapper + grouper.

zones.name: Swordfish Grounds (S. Florida)
zones.notes: 1500ft+ Gulf Stream. Daytime deep-drop sword. Buoy line.

zones.name: Bimini Edge Wall
zones.notes: Bahamas dropoff edge. Trolling pelagics.

zones.name: Pulley Ridge
zones.notes: Deep coral reef 70nm W of Tortugas. Red grouper trophy zone.

zones.name: Naples Hardbottom
zones.notes: 40nm W Naples. Winter kingfish + grouper year-round.

zones.name: Ft Myers Ledge (140ft)
zones.notes: Deep ledge system 50nm SW Fort Myers.

zones.name: Edison Reef
zones.notes: State artificial reef 15nm W Fort Myers.
